fire: The new processor has eight cores and a base frequency of 3.4 GHz with boost.
Thanks to the smaller 5 nm process node, the chip runs cooler at higher clocks.
The company did not reveal the GPU's core clock or its power consumption.
Overclocking the Ryzen chip pushed its boost speed past 4.8 GHz on air cooling.
Performance depends mainly on core count and clock speed for these workloads.
The graphics card ships with a factory overclock and a larger heatsink.
Lowering the clocks slightly improved yield without hurting benchmark scores.
Intel raised the turbo frequency of its desktop CPUs by another 200 MHz.
quiet: The new phone has a 6.1-inch screen and a battery rated at 4,000 mAh.
Thanks to the larger sensor, the camera takes cleaner photos in low light.
The company did not reveal the laptop's screen resolution or its weight.
Upgrading the hard drive to an SSD made the old laptop boot much faster.
Performance depends mainly on storage speed and network latency for these workloads.
The monitor ships with a height-adjustable stand and two HDMI ports.
Lowering the screen brightness slightly improved battery life without hurting readability.
Samsung raised the storage capacity of its portable drives by another terabyte.
